about: Where Ben placed HUD pieces himself (w894). ui_layout.py pins checks every census against these, whatever the pull request's parent looked like: a move an earlier PR made does not become the new normal. A pin changes only when the person asks, quoted in its 'who', through a harness PR. Rects are screen pixels from the top-left; fractions are of the screen's width (W) or height (H). A pin whose element is not on screen in a census is 'not shown' there: take the census with a station selected and the hover card up. A pin with 'coveredBy' that the game hides by design under a docked window (the hover card, w2185) is 'covered' there, not 'not shown', when another census of the run measures it. A pin with 'when' applies only where one of its alternatives holds (featureOn / featureOff: a toggle id in the census's "features", which DeckTour writes; layout; shown / notShown: an element on screen or not), else it is 'not applied' there (w2651: the inventory rail, toggle inventory-rail, has its own places).
